record: synthetic: straight route, random band-limited record, seeds [20261030, 20261031]

layers.name: L0_admission
layers.notes: the record is generated, so there is no measurement admission to make; the numbers here describe the class the operator is calibrated on

layers.name: L1_registration
layers.notes: one synthetic channel against one rail: there is no second channel to register

layers.name: L2_calibration
layers.notes: same-class 6 of 8, tone 3 of 8 at the same bins; the tone transfer is 1.1-1.8x larger, and an eight-fold tone amplitude change moves |H| by 0.17 %, so the gap is the multi-harmonic composition and not the amplitude

layers.name: L3_inversion
layers.notes: the layer inverts inside its declared class; whether 6 of 8 meets the criterion is the acceptance layer's call, not this one's

layers.name: L4_uncertainty
layers.notes: no held-out coverage: two test seeds are the whole sample, so a coverage number would be a claim about the sample rather than about the estimator

layers.name: L5_acceptance
layers.notes: 6 of 8 bands inside 2 dB: below the 8 of 8 the criterion asks for, so no measurement claim follows

measurement_validation_meaning: no acceptance layer has run; nothing about the measurement may be claimed
degradation: amplitude claims are class-limited: the same-class operator reaches 6 of 8, the tone-calibrated one 3 of 8, and a 24-harmonic record measured 1.14-1.78 in |H| away from a pure tone at the same rms -- an amplitude number is only meaningful with its calibration class attached
0.1000-0.1732 m (142-195 Hz) is degraded: round 192 measured a 5.3-7.6x gain spread there, with mean penetration leaving the 65.47 um static value
no uncertainty layer: L4 needs a held-out set this route does not have, so no +/- sigma is quoted
